card.name: Container and equipment sizes in preparation steps
card.fires_on: Digits and units giving the size of lab or pharmacy containers and fittings (test tubes, ViaLok, IV bags), and the word amber before glass or PET bottles, in preparation or dispensing directions.

modes.label: Size numbers and mm
modes.description: The last digit of a dimension or the unit mm for tubes, hubs or bags.

modes.label: Amber before bottle
modes.description: The word amber describing the glass or plastic bottle used to dispense or store a liquid.
